verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover assigning roles to members [launchdarkly-docs-36] and API access tokens [launchdarkly-docs-37], so role-based access and API tokens are documented, with approvals [launchdarkly-docs-6] adding a further control on flag changes. The evidence consists only of page titles, so it does not show how finely access can be restricted. missing for 10: evidence of per-flag or per-environment permission scoping (custom role policies), explicit documentation that API tokens can be scoped to limited permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
